operations.create: Create one task-scoped STATE.json through current_admission.build_initial_state.
operations.read: Read the task STATE.json and its exact referenced artifacts; observe_article returns the validated stage and next action.
operations.update: Change requirements through current_admission.apply_task_requirement_change; preserve append-only history and invalidate dependent evidence.
operations.delete: Do not erase historical receipts or accepted evidence. Retire requirements/methods through lifecycle operations; delete only disposable unreferenced temporary artifacts.
operations.delivery: Store actual DOCX, render receipts and verified page evidence under the same article delivery workspace.
operations.source_create: BLOCKED until the canonical repository is PRIVATE and the hosted Financial Provider Action is live; then create a source identity, immutable first version, provenance manifest, and signed effect receipt atomically.
operations.source_read: Read only by exact source_id and version_id; verify raw-byte SHA-256, normalized-text SHA-256, Git blob identities, and provenance.
operations.source_update: Append a new immutable source version and CAS-update the current-version pointer; never overwrite an admitted version.
operations.source_delete: RETIRE by default; preserve existing article bindings and history. Hard delete is forbidden for referenced sources and requires a separate approved history/backup purge for legal erasure.
operations.source_list_search: Search source metadata and return exact version-pinned references; filename-only matching is not authoritative.

external_inputs.chat: Source of user intent and explicit approval; never a shadow article-state store.
external_inputs.research_sources: External URLs and uploaded files must be admitted into the canonical versioned source library before they can become durable task evidence.
external_inputs.github_provider: Canonical storage and exact CAS/readback authority only after repository privacy and live Provider Action gates are verified.
external_inputs.temporary_files: Ephemeral work products only; never canonical state or a substitute source library.
